name: com.stackyoga.yogabase-runtime-host
description: Preview Unity runtime-host client for a Yogabase-hosted self-contained dedicated server workload. Talks to the Pod-local runtime-host relay over loopback (heartbeat, Ready, resume-token assignment polling, Shutdown) with no third-party dependency: only System.Text.Json and HttpClient, read exclusively through the JSON DOM so IL2CPP managed stripping at Medium/High cannot break it via reflection. This is a local, unpublished preview; it is not distributed through any package registry.
